title: Optimized processing of Gardenia Fruits with ginger juice: Unveiling therapeutic mechanisms for cholestatic liver injury through TLR4/NF-kappaB, FXR/PPAR-alpha, and PI3K/AKT/GSK-3beta.
authors: Lyu, Chenzi; Meng, Xianglong; Wang, Juan; Shao, Haifeng; Wang, Yang; Park, Yong-Ki; Zhang, Shuosheng; Jung, Hyo Won
one_liner_zh: 该文研究栀子姜汁炮制优化及其对胆汁淤积性肝损伤的疗效机制，涉及TLR4/NF-kB等信号通路，与蛋白质-DNA互作及TF-DNA结合建模完全无关。
abstract: The study aimed to optimize the processing conditions of Gardeniae Fructus with ginger juice (GFPG) and confirm its therapeutic effects and pharmacological mechanisms on cholestatic liver injury. Processing conditions were optimized using response surface methodology (RSM) and thermal analysis, focusing on geniposide content as a key active compound. Variables included processing time, moistening time, and the solid-liquid ratio. Optimal conditions were: ginger juice to Gardeniae Fructus ratio of 8:1 (w/v), processing temperature of 208  degrees C, moistening time of 3 hours, and processing time of 5 minutes. Pharmacological mechanisms were analyzed through network pharmacology, molecular docking, and experimental validation using alpha-naphthyl isothiocyanate (ANIT)-induced cholestatic liver injury in mice and lipopolysaccharide (LPS)-stimulated RAW264.7 cell models. In vivo, GFPG extract alleviated ANIT-induced cholestatic liver injury by improving liver function markers (AST, ALT, TBA, TBIL, DBIL) and modulating TLR4/NF-kappaB, FXR/PPAR-alpha, and PI3K/AKT/GSK-3beta pathways. In vitro, it reduced LPS-induced production of inflammatory mediators (NO, TNF-alpha, IL-6, IL-1beta) through TLR4/NF-kappaB pathway inhibition. This study established optimal processing methods for GFPG using RSM and thermal analysis, providing robust quantitative parameters. GFPG demonstrated significant therapeutic effects in cholestatic liver injury models, indicating its potential as a candidate for developing treatments for cholestatic hepatitis.
abstract_zh: 本研究旨在优化栀子姜汁炙（GFPG）的加工条件，并确认其对胆汁淤积性肝损伤的治疗效果及药理机制。采用响应面法（RSM）和热分析优化加工条件，以栀子苷含量作为关键活性成分，变量包括加工时间、闷润时间和固液比。最优条件为：姜汁与栀子比为8:1（w/v），加工温度208°C，闷润时间3小时，加工时间5分钟。通过网络药理学、分子对接及实验验证分析药理机制，实验模型包括α-萘异硫氰酸酯（ANIT）诱导的小鼠胆汁淤积性肝损伤和脂多糖（LPS）刺激的RAW264.7细胞模型。体内实验中，GFPG提取物通过改善肝功能指标（AST、ALT、TBA、TBIL、DBIL）并调节TLR4/NF-κB、FXR/PPAR-α和PI3K/AKT/GSK-3β通路，缓解了ANIT诱导的胆汁淤积性肝损伤。体外实验中，它通过抑制TLR4/NF-κB通路，减少了LPS诱导的炎症介质（NO、TNF-α、IL-6、IL-1β）产生。本研究利用RSM和热分析确立了GFPG的最佳加工方法，提供了可靠的定量参数。GFPG在胆汁淤积性肝损伤模型中显示出显著的治疗效果，表明其作为胆汁淤积性肝炎治疗候选药物的潜力。
